study.question: Observed limitation: the inspected global-summary source expands block-constant coarse coefficients to [B,10,10] before repeated centering, projection and norm reductions. Can evaluation-only count-weighted [B,10,1] projections reduce measured prediction cost while retaining all event inputs, learned capacity, gates and the frozen training path? This follows multiple trajectories: global-summary contraction changed click AUC from 0.6675003890552496 to 0.6675018907227037 and p50 from 15.3391 to 14.5342 ms in round69, but the next-round global reference was 14.7050 ms and 28.0482 s end-to-end. In round70 direct layout changed p50 by +0.0579%, pool contraction by -0.1029%, and their combination by about -0.2966%; those one-run differences do not establish useful acceleration. Earlier whole-embedding12, half readout and recent ID12-linear reductions lost click AUC (0.6641111849, 0.6652781389 and 0.6670156484 respectively); they do not refute this execution-only hypothesis.
study.hypothesis: For a coefficient constant on valid events of block b, every sum and inner product equals a sum over ten block coefficients weighted by valid count n_b. Replacing replicated-event orthogonal projections with that weighted arithmetic can reduce transient FP32 work without discarding predictive information. This is exact over real arithmetic, including partial/noncontiguous blocks, but FP32 reduction order can change norm threshold gates, subsequently BF16 coefficients and predictions. Kernel-launch overhead, broadcast/gather costs or other bottlenecks may remove any timing gain. This is an unverified execution-efficiency hypothesis, not evidence that learned parameters can be removed, not a new architecture or priority claim.

Change only the prediction-time residual projection representation; retain global contraction, all coefficient alternatives and original normalization thresholds.

study.proposed_difference: One 2x2 factorial using a new architectural execution option evaluation_coarse_projection: event (byte-identical parent control), quadratic (only quadratic/scrambled orthogonal residual projection and its norms use block-count weights), cubic (only cubic/scrambled two-sweep projection and its norms use block-count weights), both (their combination). The quadratic residual is a basis for cubic projection, so the interaction cell is necessary. In the cubic branch gather one valid event per block for each already-computed basis, including blocks with masked first position; zero-count blocks contribute zero. Expand residuals back through the original validity mask before inherited normalization, support gates and contractions. No coefficient alternative or support test is deleted, even when its normalized output is discarded. A representative FP32 projection residual decreases from B*100 to B*10 entries (3,276,800 versus 327,680 bytes at B8192); this is a symbolic workspace count, not measured peak GPU memory or an end-to-end speed estimate.
predictions: Before host screening freeze preservation criteria: click AUC(candidate)-AUC(concurrent weighted_reference) >= -0.00001 on all 2,871,767 validation samples, and candidate AUC >=0.666653547526167 (frozen entry 0.666753547526167 minus0.0001). Require per-task AUC degradation <=0.0001 and each task Logloss increase <=0.00001 relative to concurrent reference. These are operational tolerances, not statistical noninferiority evidence.

At fixed state all initial parameters, buffers, train-mode predictions/loss/gradients/Dice updates and one optimizer step should be identical under the same precision and deterministic execution. Evaluation should preserve masks, counts, population, coefficient support semantics and all output shapes. Compare actual FP32 gate decisions, norms, five summaries, three pooled strata and all four probabilities at empty, full, short, sparse, noncontiguous and near-degenerate supports when the host exposes diagnostics; do not infer floating-point equivalence from symbolic checks.

Both single factors should reduce the corresponding residual arithmetic workspace without changing parameter or optimizer-state counts; the combination can have an interaction through the quadratic basis and shared bandwidth. Runtime benefit is not assumed additive.

Freeze cost criterion: a provisional candidate must meet quality gates, improve same-round model p50 by at least2%, have model p95 <=101% of reference, and reduce full-population inference seconds by at least1%. Confirm direction in at least two of three same-protocol comparisons, with the median meeting these thresholds, before an efficiency claim. Include casts, count weighting, gather/expansion and all preparation in timing. Use existing host metrics; do not compare cross-round wall-time numbers as a controlled estimate.

Select among confirmed eligible cells by lowest median measured model p50, then lower median full inference seconds, then fewer changed factors; retain the existing global parent if none qualifies. Training time should be unchanged within noise and total parameters exactly unchanged. Full-population validation and all four task metrics remain required.
falsifiers: A reproducible validation AUC/Logloss loss beyond the frozen tolerances rejects utility of that implementation even if speed improves; do not change the margin after seeing results.
No repeated cost reduction under the frozen thresholds rejects an efficiency claim even if the symbolic residual workspace is smaller. A launch-bound implementation is a valid negative result.

Any changed training source path, parameter/buffer/RNG ownership, input/mask population, auxiliary stop-gradient or Dice update violates this execution-only contrast and must be corrected before interpreting results.

At a common state, FP32 norm/support gates that disagree at consequential cases invalidate numerical model-preservation attribution. Diagnose without rewriting thresholds or history policy. Missing diagnostic access leaves gate-preservation support unresolved even if measured quality passes.

If the unchanged bridge fails to reproduce click AUC0.6675018907227037 within0.000001 under the pinned recipe, stop comparative interpretation and investigate execution/source/data integrity rather than tune the control.
alternative_explanations: FP32 reduction and multiplication order can change residual norms around1e-10 or1e-12; support changes can carry information. BF16 conversion and downstream rounding can shift scores without new information.

Tensor-kernel launches, gather/expansion and loading overhead may dominate arithmetic bandwidth. Different allocator state, thermal clocks, run order or concurrent load can imitate a small speedup; single-run p50 changes in round70 were below0.3%.

Quadratic and cubic changes interact because the latter uses the former as a basis; the full factorial distinguishes main effects and interaction rather than comparing only the combined cell.
